text: Experience Abu Dhabi is a tourism brand of the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi (DCT Abu Dhabi), a government agency of Abu Dhabi.

source.name: Sportico (Eben Novy-Williams): Knicks’ Experience Abu Dhabi Jersey Patch Sticks Out At Uncertain Time
source.quote: The Knicks and Abu Dhabi’s government have a broad deal that includes much of the MSG empire.
